name: Steamed Brown Bread Rolls
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Beat 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg together
Add 2 1/2 cups buttermilk, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon soda, 3 cups Graham flour and enough white flour to make a stiff batter
Have ready 4 one-pound baking powder cans, well greased, lids and all
Fill the cans half-full of Graham batter
Put on lids and steam 2 1/2 hours
Remove from steamer and set in oven for 15 minutes with lids off
Turn upside down and with a little shaking turn out on a board

source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat 1/2 cup sugar and 1 egg together
2. Add 2 1/2 cups buttermilk, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon soda, 3 cups Graham flour and enough white flour to make a stiff batter
3. Have ready 4 one-pound baking powder cans, well greased, lids and all
4. Fill the cans half-full of Graham batter
5. Put on lids and steam 2 1/2 hours
6. Remove from steamer and set in oven for 15 minutes with lids off
7. Turn upside down and with a little shaking turn out on a board
